newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran says cement production to rise to 30 mln tonn.
newsitem.headline: Iran says cement production to rise to 30 mln tonn.

text.p: Iran's cement production is expected to rise to 30 million tonnes by the end of March 1999 from 18.5 million tonnes in the last Iranian year ending March 1997, an official was on Sunday quoted as saying.
The daily newspaper Iran quoted an industry ministry official as saying seven new cement factories would come on stream with a total capacity of 2.5 million tonnes a year.

He said cement production rose by 16 percent in the first two months of the current Iranian year, but did not give figures. He said 17.5 million tonnes of cement were produced in the 1995-96 Iranian year.
Iran last year banned exports of cement and announced new rules governing its distribution to counter a surge in prices which local press reports blamed on shortages.
